title: AIPrediction
tagline: an ai prediction market powered by Eliza, help user create and bet in it
description: It is an ai prediction market, when user want to create a bet event and share it with others, usually he need to go to create page and click and input something, but now he only need to chat with agent, and agent will help him create that event, also agent can provide his own option, for example it will show hotest news in the last 24 hours, and give them to user as a choice.
how_its_made: It uses Eliza framework. Prediction market contract is written by solidity and create and bet is base on it. Frontend is written by nextjs and backend written by expressjs. User can create such a market throught twitter or telegram, he can directly leaves comment under the bot, and bot replys him throught a link with market created.
